request.prompt:
For each supplied observed change, propose at most one local, falsifiable relation to the final goal. Bind the changed entity to the intended target. Include irrelevant or insufficient possibilities. Give neutral visual questions and explicit falsifiers. No unobserved changes or full task tree. Return L2 JSON.
GOAL: Put the blue cube completely inside the transparent box so it rests on the box floor. Release it and leave it still.
CAPABILITIES: One tabletop arm can approach, grasp, carry, release and interact with visible movable structures. It cannot pass through rigid solids, teleport or resize objects. Hidden locks, load capacity and exact reach remain unknown.
OBSERVATIONS: {"changes": [], "coverage": "no_observable_change", "initial_context": [], "uncertainty": []}
OUTPUT CONTRACT: Exact top keys: claims, tests. Use at most 3 short claims and 3 short tests TOTAL, one test per claim; keep each string concise so the complete JSON fits. Claim item keys: claim_id, change_ids, goal_binding, relation_hypothesis, possible_effect, test_ids, falsifier. Effect=beneficial|harmful|irrelevant|unknown. falsifier must be a short string. Test item keys: test_id, neutral_question, entity_ids, requested_refs. requested_refs contains only supplied image evidence IDs such as f0000 or c0a; if no image evidence IDs were supplied, use []. Never put entity IDs in requested_refs. For target-first conditions at this stage, change_ids is empty. Cite supplied IDs only.

Use only the verification table and cited facts to assess claims, events, completion, direct readiness, partial preparation and reversal. Unknown is allowed. Claims are not evidence. Do not introduce new visual facts, a numeric progress score or a task tree. Return L4 JSON.
GOAL: Put the blue cube completely inside the transparent box so it rests on the box floor. Release it and leave it still.
CAPABILITIES: One tabletop arm can approach, grasp, carry, release and interact with visible movable structures. It cannot pass through rigid solids, teleport or resize objects. Hidden locks, load capacity and exact reach remain unknown.
VERIFIED_TABLE: {"change_ids": [], "claims": [], "fact_catalog": [], "facts": {"change_checks": [], "facts": [], "goal_facts": [], "missing": [], "new_unverified_changes": []}}
OUTPUT CONTRACT: Exact top keys: claim_results, events, state, state_fact_ids, net_effect, reversal, unresolved. claim_results item keys: claim_id, status, used_test_ids, short_reason; status=supported|refuted|unknown. events item keys: change_ids, impact, basis, fact_ids, reversed_event_ids; impact=beneficial|harmful|irrelevant|mixed|unknown, basis=observed|inference. state keys: goal_done, direct_ready, partial_preparation. state_fact_ids has the same three keys, each a fact ID list. Cite exact IDs from VERIFIED_TABLE.fact_catalog: a visual test fact is test_id@at (for example goal_current@current), not bare test_id; a goal fact uses criterion_id. State values=true|false|unknown|not_applicable as JSON strings; goal_done cannot be not_applicable. If goal_done=true, other states must be not_applicable. net_effect=beneficial|harmful|unchanged|mixed|unknown. reversal=true|false|unknown as JSON string. reversed_event_ids must cite a prior beneficial change ID in this output.

New visual check. Provisional entity bindings may be wrong. Answer neutral questions using newly supplied RGB pixels. Check before/after identity, current target placement, visible obstruction and persistence. A missing observation is not proof of absence. Do not assign task value. Return V3 JSON.
GOAL: Put the blue cube completely inside the transparent box so it rests on the box floor. Release it and leave it still.
NEUTRAL_QUESTIONS: {"provisional_bindings": [], "questions": [{"entity_ids": [], "neutral_question": "What visible end-state evidence supports the final goal now?", "requested_refs": ["f0011", "f0014"], "test_id": "goal_current"}]}
OUTPUT CONTRACT: Exact top keys: facts, change_checks, goal_facts, new_unverified_changes, missing. facts item keys: test_id, at, value, evidence_refs, visible_statement; at=before|after|current. change_checks item keys: change_id, exists, evidence_refs. goal_facts item keys: criterion_id, value, evidence_refs. new_unverified_changes item keys: description, evidence_refs. missing item keys: test_id, reason. value/exists=true|false|unknown as JSON strings. reason=occlusion|identity|geometry|stability|budget|out_of_prefix|not_observable.

Describe actual visible changes in chronological RGB frames. Bind entities across time. Record at most three persistent changes or reversals, and a neutral initial scene context. Robot-only motion, camera movement and occlusion are not automatically environment changes. Do not infer purpose, utility, completion or a task plan. Return only V1 JSON.
OUTPUT CONTRACT: Exact top keys: initial_context, changes, coverage, uncertainty. initial_context item keys: entity_id, description, region_id, visible_relation (max 6). changes item keys: change_id, entity_ids, before_refs, after_refs, before, after, observation, status (max 3). Use only supplied evidence IDs. The observation field is a fixed certainty label: write exactly "observed" or "uncertain", never descriptive prose; put the visual description in before and after. status=closed_event|open_event. coverage=complete|overflow|occluded|no_observable_change. uncertainty items have code, detail.
SHOWN_FULL_FRAME_TIMELINE_MS (earliest to latest): f0000@0, f0002@2000, f0005@5000, f0008@8000, f0009@9000, f0010@10000, f0011@11000, f0014@14000. Cite before_refs earlier than after_refs for each change. Similar appearance does not establish a later reversal. Compare the first and last visible state of non-robot structures before describing transient motion.
CPU_SEARCH_HINT (may be wrong): camera_uncertain=false; candidate_count=3; candidate_overflow=false. Inspect all supplied full frames.
